title: Convert a Function‑Based View to a Class‑Based View
description: Take a simple FBV and rewrite it as a CBV using the View class.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

You have a function‑based view that returns a simple greeting:

```python
def greet(request, name):
    return HttpResponse(f"Hello, {name}!")
```

Rewrite this as a class‑based view using `View`. The view should capture the `name` from the URL and return the same greeting. Use the `get()` method.
hints: Define a `get()` method that takes `self, request, name`.
